hook: A pond, a garden, a forest floor and a beach, each with six things to find. Zoom in and hear the word, play I spy from clues, then build a describing sentence and say it together.
outcome: Name living and nonliving things in nature and describe them by color, size, parts, texture and what they can do
sources: Illustrations drawn with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (Apache 2.0) on Cloudflare Workers AI, edited for Curio Class
